facts.business: Avonmore Capital & Management Services Limited is a holding company with subsidiaries engaged in financial services, securities broking, infrastructure consulting, real estate development, and other diversified businesses.

segments.name: Financial Services (Almondz Global Securities, Almondz Finanz)
Real Estate & Development (Premier Green Innovations, Avonmore Developers, Acrokx Reality)

key_risks: Concentration risk in subsidiary Premier Green Innovations contributing majority of consolidated revenue
Several subsidiaries reporting losses (Avonmore Developers, Red Solutions, Glow Apparels, Acrokx Reality, Apricot Infosoft)
High finance costs on standalone basis (Rs 526.32 lakhs)
Declining standalone total income (from Rs 2450.85 lakhs to Rs 1079.82 lakhs)
Pledged securities with lenders (Bajaj Finance, Axis Bank)
facts.related_party_note: Not explicitly detailed in excerpts; subsidiaries and associates listed with financials
